label: Rate-weighted nested cutoffs of one roster give constant arbitrary frequencies (inference)
rule: Count the two finite type slices at each stage
meaning: For positive a and b the stage-n set is the union of initial segments of lengths a(n+1) and b(n+1) in the two type fibers. The stages are nested, the instance with index k appears by stage k, and the true-type frequency is a/(a+b) at every stage, so its limit is a/(a+b).
